messages:
Sara (CS): quick check — Helix dedicated pool had a weird spike this week, can we run through GPU hours, saturation, queue depth? noticed p95 latency creep on Wed.
Mike (Support Ops): pulling dashboards now, will paste a snapshot in a sec. link: https://console.redwood/teams/helix/capacity
infra-bot: automated snapshot for tenant: helix (weekly)
```
pool: p4d-large
gpu_hours_week: 11,420
avg_saturation: 81%
peak_saturation: 95% (Wed 02:11 UTC)
avg_queue_depth: 14
peak_queue_depth: 38
p95_latency: 460ms
error_rate: 1.1%
estimated_weekly_spend: $18,900
```
Anil (Eng Runtime): seeing the same. spike on Wed aligns with a tenant retrain job + heavy inference fanout. KV cache hit rate dropped ~25% during the window.
Mike (Support Ops): breakdown by job type: interactive traffic stayed flat, async batch jobs doubled for a 3hr window. those batch jobs pinned full GPUs, so continuous batching couldn't help.
Jess (Onboarding): Helix onboarding timeline — they're moving prod cutover next Tue. if this pattern continues it's a renewal risk unless we smooth capacity.
Sara (CS): noted. three things we need: (1) temporary bump or burst capacity for next 2 weeks, (2) look at autoscale policy thresholds, (3) ask Helix to shift heavy retrains off peak. owners?
Anil (Eng Runtime): I can adjust autoscale policy: lower scale-down cooldown and add a burst slot policy for Helix. can do a PR today, monitor next 48h.
Mike (Support Ops): I'll open an internal ticket to provision 1 extra p4d node (burst) for the next 14 days and mark as billable. ticket #CS-7642
Jess (Onboarding): I'll ping the Helix PM and suggest moving retrains to UTC 08:00-14:00 window. also will surface spend impact so they can fast-track budget approval.
Sara (CS): thanks. also we should add a watch for KV cache hit rate and queue_depth > 25 as an alert channel to us. can infra-bot emit that?
infra-bot: alert rule proposal: if avg_queue_depth > 20 for >15m OR avg_saturation > 90% for >10m -> post to #customer-success and @oncall. draft posted: https://console.redwood/alerts/CS-helm-23
Anil (Eng Runtime): fine with that. I'll add a KV cache hit-rate metric to the alert and surface it in the Helix dashboard.
Sara (CS): OK action items: Anil (autoscale + alert tweaks), Mike (provision burst + cost tracking), Jess (customer coordination). we'll reconvene Fri 16:00 UTC to review. :white_check_mark:
